Subject: Novara onboarding: procurement kickoff & documentation checklist

Hi Sienna / Novara procurement team,

Welcome — excited to get Novara set up as a Redwood vendor. Below is a short kickoff and the checklist of items our procurement and finance teams need to complete vendor setup and issue the first PO. If you can return the requested docs in the next 3-5 business days, we should be able to process the PO within 7-10 business days after receipt.

What we need from you (please upload to the shared Drive or reply with attachments):
- Completed W-9 (US tax) or equivalent tax form (PDF)
- Completed ACH form for direct deposit (bank name, routing, account number)
- Certificate of Insurance (COI) showing general liability — minimum $1M if available
- Signed vendor onboarding form (I attached our minimal template) — contact, billing address, remittance info
- Any export-control / restricted countries declaration if you operate internationally
- Primary contact for billing and technical escalation (name, email, phone)

What Redwood will provide / next steps from our side:
- We will create a vendor profile in our ERP once the W-9 and ACH are received
- Legal will route the SOW/ MSA via DocuSign for signature (expect a link within 24–48 hours)
- Finance will issue a PO once banking and tax documents are validated
- Point-of-contact for onboarding: Monica Patel (procurement) and Aditya Rao (finance)

Attachments requested from us in this thread:
- Redwood vendor onboarding form (attached) — please return with fields completed

Please reply to confirm who will be the billing and tech contacts and attach any completed forms. If anything on our checklist is a blocker from your side, call my cell and we’ll work around it.

Best,

Monica Patel
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-6124
